name: Coppica API
description: Programmatic access to Coppica’s learning loop: generate persuasion-engineered copy, then report real-world outcomes against the exact output that produced them so every future generation is informed by what actually converted. Authenticate with a Bearer API key (cpk_...). Human docs: https://coppica.com/docs/api
